mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super with three charge levels. Current dedicated Xenoverse 2 documentation reports ideal-condition hit counts of 9 at Level 1, 12 at Level 2, and 15 at Level 3, with fewer hits possible at greater distance. Exact charge frames and patch-independent damage scaling remain unresolved.
